questions.question: In a quadrilateral ABCD, the bisectors of ∠C and ∠D meet at point E. If ∠CED = 57° and ∠A = 47°, then the measure of ∠B is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠CED = 57° and ∠A = 47°

**Concept used:**

The sum of the all angles of a triangle = 180°

The sum of the all angles of a quadrilateral = 360°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30c0f85882aa49c6023fd21a7713b9da51260db1254e1dced67f52eace08da42.png] 

In ΔCED, ∠CDE + ∠DCE + ∠CED = 180°

⇒ ∠D/2 + ∠C/2 + 57° = 180°

⇒ ∠D/2 + ∠C/2 = 180° - 57° = 123°

⇒ (∠D + ∠C)/2 = 123°

⇒ ∠D + ∠C = 123° × 2 = 246°

Also, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C + ∠D = 360°

⇒ 47° + ∠B + 246° = 360° [∵ ∠D + ∠C = 246°]

⇒ ∠B = 360° - 246° - 47° = 67°

**∴ The measure of ∠B is 67°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** ∠CED = 57° and ∠A = 47°

The bisectors of *∠C* and *∠D *meet at point E

∠A + ∠B = 2 ∠CED

⇒ 47° + ∠B = 2 × 57°

⇒ ∠B = 114° - 47° = 67°

∴ The measure of ∠B is 67°

questions.question: A can complete 25% of a work in 15 days. He works for 15 days and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 30 days. In how many days will A and B working together finish 50% of the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete 25% of a work in 15 days.

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = Work/Time

**Calculation:**

A takes time to complete 25% of a work = 15 days

Remaining work = 100 - 25 = 75%

A takes time to complete 100% of a work = 15 × (100/25) = 60 days

B takes time to complete 75% of a work = 30 days

B takes time to complete 100% of a work = 30 × (100/75) = 40 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f20f1a16f5b18701d7644a73cc73e355ebe7443b581a7c1efff79a9821b16d03.png] 

Total work = 120 (LCM of 60 and 40)

50% of the work = (50/100) × 120 = 60

The required time = 60/(2 + 3) = 60/5 = 12 days

**∴ A and B working together will finish the 50% of the same work in 12 days**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at a price 20% higher than their cost price and allows 10% discount on every item. Find his gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 10%

Marked price = 20% higher than their cost price

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price = 100

So, the marked price = 100 + (20% of 100) = 100 + 20 = 120

The selling price = 120 - (10% of 120) = 120 - 12 = 108

The gain percentage = 108 - 100 = 8%

**∴ The shopkeeper's gain percentage is 8%**

questions.question: What is the average of all the prime numbers between 70 and 90?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

There are the prime numbers between 70 and 90

Concept used:

Average = Sum of the terms/Number of terms

Calculation:

Prime numbers between 70 and 90 are 71, 73, 79, 83, and 89

Total prime numbers between 70 and 90 = 5

The average = (71 + 73 + 79 + 83 + 89)/5 = 395/5 = 79

**∴ The average of all the prime numbers between 70 and 90 is 79**

questions.question: Sides AB and AC of ∆ ABC are produced to points D and E, respectively. The bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at P. If ∠A = 78°, then the measure of ∠P is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Given, ∠A = 78°

If the bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at P

∠P = 90° - ∠A/2

⇒ ∠P = 90° - 78°/2

⇒ ∠P = 90° - 39° = 51°

∴ The measure of ∠P is 51°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠A = 78°

Concept used:

The sum of all angles on a straight line is 180°

The sum of all angles of a triangle is 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbd7317490e6c0f169a91c3aeacefa1f839f36d07681ffd5aea11fa47596c9d5.png] 

∠ABC + ∠CBD = 180°

⇒ ∠CBD = 180° - ∠ABC

⇒ ∠CBD/2 = (180° - ∠ABC)/2

⇒ ∠CBP = 90° - ∠ABC/2 [∵ BP is the bisector of ∠CBD]

Similarly, ∠BCP = 90° - ∠ACB/2

In ΔBCP, ∠CBP + ∠BCP + ∠P = 180°

⇒ (90° - ∠ABC/2) + (90° - ∠ACB/2) + ∠P = 180°

⇒ 180° - (∠ABC + ∠ACB)/2 + ∠P = 180°

⇒ 180° - (180° - ∠BAC)/2 + ∠P = 180°

⇒ ∠P = (180° - ∠BAC)/2

⇒ ∠P = (180° - 78°)/2

⇒ ∠P = (102°)/2 = 51°

**∴ The measure of ∠P is 51°**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

The following bar chart shows the number of students enrolled in two summer Camps A and B from 2014 to 2019.

**Calculation:**

The number of students enrolled in Camp B in 2015 and 2017 = 240 + 260 = 500

questions.question: A cyclic quadrilateral ABCD is drawn in a circle with center O. A and C are joined O. If ∠ABC = 2p and ∠ADC = 3p, what is the measure (in degrees) of the ∠AOC reflex?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ABC = 2p and ∠ADC = 3p

**Concept used:**

The reflex angle is more than 180° but less than 360°

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°

The angle at the center of a circle is twice the angle at the circumference of the circle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/795646e00334bce07a5bfc6e486643bdfa4dd9ed73e1df9d2a43a63ea4c498a5.png] 

∠ABC + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ 2p + 3p = 180°

⇒ 5p = 180°

⇒ p = 180°/5 = 36°

So, ∠ABC = 2 × 36° = 72° and ∠ADC = 3 × 36° = 108°

Then ∠AOC = 2 × 72° = 144° [∵ ∠ABC = 72°] (Concept used)

Another side of ∠AOC =360° - 144° = 216°

**∴ The measure (in degrees) of the ∠AOC reflex is 216°**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 6, a² + b² + c² = 32, and a³ + b³ + c³ = 189, then the value of abc - 3 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 6

a2 + b2 + c2 = 32

a3 + b3 + c3 = 189

**Formula used:**

x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz = (x + y + z) [x² + y² + z² - (xy + yz + zx)]

(x + y + z)² = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2 (xy + yz + zx)

**Calculation:**

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 6² = 32 + 2 (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 36 = 32 + 2 (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2 (ab + bc + ca) = 36 - 32 = 4

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 4/2 = 2

Also, a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c) [a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 189 - 3abc = 6 (32 - 2)

⇒ 189 - 3abc = 6 × 30

⇒ 3abc = 189 - 180 = 9

⇒ abc = 9/3 = 3

⇒ abc - 3 = 3 - 3 = 0

**∴ The value of abc - 3 is 0**

questions.question: The cost prices of two articles A and B are in the ratio 4 ∶ 5. While selling these articles, the shopkeeper gains 10% on article A and 20% on article B and the difference in their selling prices is Rs. 480. The difference in the cost price (in Rs.) of articles B and A is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the cost prices of two articles A and B = 4 ∶ 5

The difference in the selling price of the article = Rs. 480

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 + Profit%)/100] × C.P.

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price of two articles are 4x and 5x

So, [5x × (120/100)] - [4x × (110/100)] = 480

⇒ (600x/100) - (440x/100) = 480

⇒ 160x/100 = 480

⇒ x = 480 × (100/160) = 300

The difference in the cost price = 5x - 4x = x = Rs. 300

**∴ The difference in the cost price (in Rs.) of articles B and A is Rs. 300**

questions.question: 11over5 of a number A is 22% of a number B. The number B is equal to 2.5% of a third number C. If the value of C is 5500, then the sum of 80% of A and 40% of B is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

(11/5) × A = (22/100) × B

⇒ A = B/10

⇒ A/B = 1/10

Also, B = (2.5/100) × C

⇒ B = C/40 [∵ 2.5% = 1/40]

⇒ B/C = 1/40

⇒ B/C = 10/400 [∵ A/B = 1/10]

Here, 400 units = 5500

⇒ 1 unit = 5500/400 = 55/4

The sum of 80% of A and 40% of B = [(4/5) × (55/4)] + [(2/5) × (550/4)] [∵ 80% = 4/5 and 40% = 2/5]

= 11 + 55

= 66

∴ The sum of 80% of A and 40% of B is 66

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

11/5 of a number A is 22% of a number B

The number B is equal to 2.5% of a third number C

The value of C = 5500

**Calculation:**

B = (2.5/100) × C

⇒ B = (2.5/100) × 5500

⇒ B = 137.5

Also, (11/5) × A = (22/100) × B

⇒ (11/5) × A = (22/100) × 137.5

⇒ A = (22/100) × (1375/10) × (5/11)

⇒ A = 13.75

Then, the sum of 80% of A and 40% of B = [13.75 × (80/100)] + [137.5 × (40/100)]

= 11 + 55

= 66

**∴ The sum of 80% of A and 40% of B is 66**
